risks.risk: Shared workspace store introduces cross-surface state coupling
risks.mitigation: V3.10B first: store + read-only followers; keep per-page hooks as followers behind adapters; no science/API change

risks.risk: Causal leakage (future events/stints visible at T)
risks.mitigation: feed + stint + sector components take T as prop and filter <= T; pathology P9/P10 checks per stage
terminology_audit.json is the gate: every simplified label maps to its full semantics location; P8 check per stage

risks.risk: Selected-driver divergence (two selections for two panels)
risks.mitigation: single key (driverId+raceId); PredictionPanel gating pattern becomes the shared rule
single frameIndex source; followers admit only exact race+index+clock (existing useSpatialTrack pattern)
responsive_product_model.json enforced with 390px wireframe review per stage

risks.risk: A11y regression from dense telemetry aesthetics (P19)
risks.mitigation: retain landmarks, live regions, focus-visible, non-color status, reduced-motion kill-switch; replay controls keep native semantics

risks.risk: Strategy/counterfactual recommendation-language creep (P14) and causal-claim creep (P13)
risks.mitigation: entry copy frozen to audit wording; reviews grep for recommend/optimal/should-have language
eligibility 3678/9644 (38.14%) recorded deferred; no MC2 scripts in V3.10 stages

recommended_sequence: V3.10B: shared replay/workspace state architecture (store + followers, no UI change)
V3.10C: simplified pit-wall shell + 4-item navigation (routes untouched, nav only)
V3.10D: replay + event feed integration (causal-gated feed + timeline markers)
V3.10E: selected-driver intelligence integration (compact MODEL/SIM/Δ + DETAILS)
V3.10F: sector/lap + tyre stint telemetry (completed-only, causal-gated)
V3.10G: strategy/counterfactual contextual integration (prefilled entries, V3.6/V3.7 semantics)
sequencing_rationale: state before shell (B before C) so navigation never fronts divergent clocks; feed before intelligence (D before E) so DETAILS deep-links have a T to point at; telemetry (F) after intelligence demand exists; strategy/counterfactual (G) last among features as pure consumers of shared state; polish + freeze close.
